# External Samples

Use this folder for public datasets, open-source examples, or externally authorized programming-assignment samples.

Required metadata:

```text
source_type=external
data_origin=PUBLIC or HISTORICAL_AUTHORIZED
synthetic=false
provenance.source includes URL, package name, or local source note
license_or_authorization includes license, terms, or written authorization
```

Never include private student submissions unless authorization and anonymization are documented.
